explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 102 named tracks and releases across Juno's same-day and weekly techno pages, current back-in-stock records, adjacent electro and drum-and-bass releases, and overlooked catalogue/repress material. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The canonical ledger, annotations, journey map, discussion and revisit queues, rejected and discovery histories, inspiration files, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. UTF-8, JSON, count, map-order, receipt and protected-order checks passed; no objective defect, listener authorization, triggered revisit or unfinished repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded. Eight fresh exact-title leads remain; no ranking slot was filled for resolver convenience.
Run 261's evidence guard was applied. One lead per release was selected, and every ranked lead has materially differentiating exact-track prose rather than shared release framing alone.

Planned placements were compared with the previous five completed discovery runs. Recently repeated evaluated boundaries were avoided; Run 269's vetoed, unevaluated request hypotheses were not treated as musical decisions.

Source descriptions remain attributed prose, not measurements. No energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, mixability or transition quality was inferred. Neither protected handoff was split.

Rank reflects evidence specificity, selection-lens relevance, canonical potential and information gain, not novelty, orthodoxy, diversity, technical cleverness, artist prestige or a fixed chapter map.

sourceWindows: CURRENT: Juno's same-day and weekly techno pages were screened across current releases and preorders, checked 2026-09-15. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/today/ and https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/this-week/

ADJACENT / EMERGING: Juno's current back-in-stock window supplied exact-track accounts spanning Kenji Hina's garage-techno/tool vocabulary, Francisco's electro reorder, DJ Teeth's acid-house adjacency and Pugilist's technoid drum-and-bass restraint, checked 2026-09-15. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/back-in-stock/

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / RECIRCULATION: Back-in-stock and repress paths returned Dimi Angélis, Nathan Pinder and other 2026 catalogue records with track-specific descriptions; generic or previously decided identities were excluded. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/back-in-stock/
